items.text: Let it be. Haley took my earlier hint, found the camp, armored up, killed the cave troll that killed Chris, took its key, and walked straight to The Door — she is standing there right now reading *Walked out of here: Gavin, who got out*, which is the exact thing I built for the exact moment it was built for. She is unstuck, winning, and mid-stride; a voice from the air would land on top of it. No deploy either — she is still in there.
